question: Within what prescribed range may the stalk be fashioned according to desire?
premises: The stalk may be made as desired.
This freedom operates within eight measures.
The instruction is addressed to the twice-born.
inference: Choice of stalk length is permitted within the eightfold prescribed measures.
uncertainties: The precise referent of vasusaṃkhyāsu is context-dependent.
plain_english: O twice-born, the stalk may be made as desired within the eight measures taught by me.
